# 马克笔关键词

Component ID: shotcraft-marker-title

## Purpose and selection

- Emphasize one short keyword in a title with a quick human marker gesture.

Do not use:

- Not a correction or negation; do not combine the underline with simultaneous keyword bounce or camera movement.

## Supported inputs

- prefix: Leading title text, at most 8 characters.
- keyword: Exactly one key term, 1–6 characters; its measured width owns the underline.
- suffix: Following title text, at most 8 characters.

## Reading order and motion

- Settle the title before emphasis
- Draw a textured marker beneath the measured keyword

Pattern: kinetic-type. Native default duration: 3.3s. Minimum final readable hold: 0.7s.

### title

- Target: .sc-title
- Visible action: Settle the title before emphasis
- Authored start: 0.65s; action duration: 0.7333333333333333s.
- Narration cue: Bind to the exact measured spoken phrase for: Settle the title before emphasis. Do not estimate from text length.

### underline

- Target: .sc-stroke
- Visible action: Draw a textured marker beneath the measured keyword
- Authored start: 1.72s; action duration: 0.3333333333333333s.
- Narration cue: Bind to the exact measured spoken phrase for: Draw a textured marker beneath the measured keyword. Do not estimate from text length.

These are authored event defaults, not measured speech alignment. Rebind active events to actual narration at project FPS; omitted capacity items must not acquire phantom cues.
